zh: 模型的内层 token loop 与 runtime 的外层 action loop 是两个不同状态机
结构化 decoding 保证语法边界，不保证语义、权限或完成
环境 observation 和 verifier 用于切断自回归错误累积
en: The model's inner token loop and the runtime's outer action loop are separate state machines
Constrained decoding protects syntax, not semantics, authorization, or completion
Environment observations and verifiers interrupt autoregressive error accumulation
